data.description:
Scope: `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/**` (95 files, 27,284 LOC, 42% comment density). ~970 lines leave — the largest shard.

Dominant category: 28 sites carrying 'RELOCATED VERBATIM ... forced by the LOCKED 800-line cap' (~75 lines), already single-sourced in `.github/module-size-limit.txt`, AGENTS.md and ADR 0058.

Four new ADRs proposed, each consolidating an argument restated 4-8 times: field-convergence fit-then-normalize (8 sites); pagination-stall aborts past fail-open handlers (3 independent arguments, 3 prior incidents); unmapped relations skipped not approximated; core owns the value maps. Plus amendments to ADR 0028, 0055 §(g), 0031, 0035.

Verified stale: `_backend_registry.py:3` 'STUB: signatures pinned, bodies to be implemented' while `select_backend` is imported by 13 modules; the S3/S4-not-landed notes in `_backend.py` and `adapters/jira/backend.py`.

Headroom: `_ref_lock.py` 1 -> ~21, `dispatch_one.py` 14 -> ~57, `inbound_differ.py` 18 -> ~66, `binding_store.py` 18 -> ~33, `fetcher.py` 29 -> ~80.

This subtree's comments are overwhelmingly measured external-API facts that cannot be re-derived from code. The do_not_move list is the most valuable output of the shard.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every non-KEEP unit in scope is relocated or deleted per its destination
- [ ] The shard's do_not_move list is appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit lands
- [ ] Verified-stale comments are corrected where they document a live invariant, deleted only where obsolete
- [ ] No load-bearing invariant is lost; measured-fact and anti-refactor warnings stay verbatim
data.title: Comment triage: reconciler subtree
